title: Wrinkling of a bilayered cylinder under tension
summary: We study near-surface tension instabilities in bilayered cylinders composed of an incompressible core coated with a thin compressible film. In theory, circumferential wrinkles with axial wavefronts may appear on the outer surface when the cylinder is stretched. We analyze these instabilities through modelling, numerics, finite element simulations, and controlled experiments. We show that the wrinkle amplitude and wavelength depend on the Poisson ratio of the coating and the ratio of the film and substrate shear moduli.
